facts.fact: Pamela 打给年轻人无人接听，随后决定不把医生昨天下午说的情况转告 Jo
facts.anchor: Why don’t young people ever answer their phones?

facts.fact: 医生推测她的膝痛或与髋部僵硬有关、是「会迁移的问题」，Pamela 脱口说「就像我妹妹」，医生笑得有点不安
facts.anchor: Just like my sister, she’d blurted, and he’d smiled, a little uneasily.

facts.fact: 昨夜妹妹 Miriam 侵入 Pamela 的梦：像一团薄纱、拿窗帘当翅膀飞；她警告自己别让妹妹再主宰白天
facts.anchor: Miriam invaded her dreams last night, flying through them in a cloud of tulle, curtains for wings.

facts.fact: 亡夫 Tony 去世已四年，Pamela 对着他的照片微笑、在照片前吃饭，想他想得要命
facts.anchor: Four years since he passed, and she misses him something rotten.

facts.fact: 苗圃和破旧房屋无人出价；Tony 生前瞒着她贷款（不想让她担心），她以债养债，除国家养老金外身无分文
facts.anchor: Apart from the state pension, she’s flat broke.

facts.fact: 自从在《每日邮报》网上读到那场「sensational」的 life-in-objects 拍卖，过去又开始渗回、漫进现在
facts.anchor: Since she’d read in the Daily Mail online about the ‘sensational’ life-in-objects auction

facts.fact: 直到 Miriam 的丈夫在楠塔基特外海的游艇上心脏病发作去世，Pamela 才第一次为妹妹担心
facts.anchor: A heart attack on some yacht off the coast of Nantucket.

facts.fact: Pamela 写了八封吊唁信，每封都被攥成一团扔进火里；那封信最终没有寄出——她不能冒接触之险
facts.anchor: Pamela wrote eight letters of condolence; each one balled in the fist and tossed into the fire.
